row:
Equine Guelph, a not-for-profit Centre at the University of Guelph, serves the horse industry through education, research, and career support.

Equine Guelph is the leader in Online Studies for equine pursuits, boasting 20 accredited 12-week university level courses with highly-qualified instructors and expert guests. Plus, award-winning short courses that provide practical information and tips from equine industry and healthcare experts and feature the most up-to-date research and latest evidence-based resources. With these you can stay with your horses and balance your busy schedule.   

Explore our Free interactive tools to help you address a range of healthcare issues which may affect your horse(s). These free tools allow you to assess your own individual situation with practical recommendations you can take right to your barn.

A channel dedicated to improving the health and well-being of horses and providing evidence-based education for horse people.
